From: Alice Murray <alice.murray@silverbank.com>

Cc: security@silverbank.com, Docs Team <docs-team@silverbank.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Oct 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Crypto evidence onboarding for SilverBank - initial request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this. As discussed on the call, SilverBank needs a compact evidence packet we can route to our InfoSec intake (SOC2/SIG review). At a minimum, please include the following items for the Redwood tenant that will host our production workloads (we reference the tenant ID on the call):

- KMS provider and key lifecycle diagram (who can create/rotate/export keys)
- HSM attestation / vendor firmware version and date (or equivalent statement of non-exportability)
- Key rotation cadence and recent rotation log sample (last 90 days)
- Operator access matrix + RBAC/SCIM mapping for the keystore operators
- TLS configuration summary for transit and signed cert chain details
- Snapshot of at-rest encryption settings and KMS key policies (redacted as needed)
- Sample audit logs for key usage (time-window and obfuscated key IDs is fine)

We are trying to complete our intake by Oct 24; ideally we can get a first delivery by Oct 20 so the reviewer has time to validate before the deadline. Please let me know the timeline and whether you need a signed NDA amendment or a specific format for the artifacts (ZIP vs link to a secure share).

Appreciate the help — if easier, we can accept a staged delivery (core artifacts first, follow-up with logs).

Best,
Alice Murray
Security Operations Manager
SilverBank

--
Attachment: silverbank-evidence-checklist-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 58KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Crypto evidence onboarding for SilverBank - initial request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list and the template. We can provide the full packet; below is our proposed delivery plan and a couple of clarifying questions.

Proposed delivery (staged):
1) Oct 19 — Core artifacts: KMS provider diagram, HSM attestation statement, rotation cadence and policy, operator matrix, TLS summary, key policy snapshots.
2) Oct 19-20 — Audit log sample and redacted rotation logs (we will coordinate exact windows).
3) Oct 21 — Optional: deeper telemetery export (if requested) and follow-up Qs.

Clarifications:
- Is SilverBank requesting customer-managed keys (BYOK) for the initial tenant, or will the tenant use Redwood-managed keys? The artifacts differ slightly (BYOK includes import/export MFA prompts and customer KMS lockfiles).
- For audit logs: is an obfuscated key ID format acceptable? We typically provide key-hash prefixes and timestamps to preserve tenant separation.

Owners:
- Marissa Cole (Security) will own the HSM attestation and policy snapshots.
- Jonas Weber (Infra) will pull rotation logs and telemetry samples.
- Laura Bennett (Compliance) will assemble the final ZIP and upload to a secure share.

If that timeline works for you we’ll proceed. We can also sign a narrow NDA addendum if your legal team requires it for artefacts containing operator details.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
